adaptationPrinciples: 1. Comprehensive Inventory: 100% covers all 40 test files in langchain4j-anthropic/src/test/java and tracked inherited base classes (core/common/reactive test bases).

2. Honest Status: No false passes. All ported tests have real local test methods with equivalent assertions and passing status (6 items PORTED/PASSED); unimplemented in-scope items strictly remain PORT_PENDING and NOT_EXECUTED_PENDING_IMPLEMENTATION (272 items); no SKIPPED pseudo-passes.

3. Precise Capability Mismatch: OUT_OF_SCOPE items strictly document the specific architectural mismatch (e.g., SDK Builder equals/hash/toBuilder facade, Batch API, count_tokens, model catalog, AiServices facade, server tools/skills, SDK automatic retry, Reactive Streams Publisher/TCK/BlockHound, third-party caching proxy, arbitrary custom headers/userId).

4. Credential IT Separation: Credential-bound integration tests are not dismissed as OUT_OF_SCOPE; they map to deterministic offline fixture targets (PORT_PENDING) while retaining an independent realInteropStatus of NOT_EXECUTED_REQUIRES_CREDENTIAL.
5. Replay Core Preserved: Disabled thinking/signature tests are recognized as replay core capabilities and mapped to offline deterministic fixtures.
6. Security & Sanitization: Sensitive header and error body logging constraints are explicitly tracked via securityAdaptation.
